game: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (Data East USA, 1991)

sections.Profile:
Released by Data East, TMNT pinball features classic TMNT characters and artwork by Kevin O'Connor and Paul Faris. It includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, two ramps, and a spinning disc. The game also features voice characterizations by Fred Young, adding to the immersive experience. The machine is known for its vibrant graphics and nostalgic appeal, capturing the essence of the early '90s cartoon series.
